column1: # Weft sync 11-22 content redrawn in our style (art-weft-content): upstream's new plants and forest mushrooms.
# Tall plants: top in the upper square, bottom right under it, so the stem runs on. @- tiles go into CTM folders by hand.

column3: inula_top|plant|Inula (elecampane) flower heads, the upper half of a tall plant: two or three big yellow daisy-like flowers with many thin ray petals (#f5c518 #d49a0c #ffe86a) round golden-orange centres (#d9801a) on sturdy green stems (#587827 #75a035) that run out of the bottom edge, a few pointed leaves
column4: verbascum_top|plant|Great mullein (verbascum), the upper half of a tall plant: one thick woolly stem rising out of the bottom edge into a dense spike of small pale sulphur-yellow five-petalled flowers (#f2d84a #c9a925 #fff08a), narrow, about 8 px wide
column5: inula_bottom|plant|Inula (elecampane), the lower half of a tall plant: sturdy green stems (#587827 #75a035) rising from the ground to the top edge, big broad pointed green leaves (#425a1d #587827 #75a035) spreading out low, a bushy clump about 26 px wide
column6: verbascum_bottom|plant|Great mullein (verbascum), the lower half of a tall plant: one thick woolly grey-green stem rising to the top edge, a rosette of big soft furry grey-green leaves at the bottom (#758a64 #9aae86 #c4d1b4), about 28 px wide

column3: lavender_top|plant|Lavender, the upper half of a tall plant: five or six slim grey-green stems (#5c7552 #7f9a72) rising from the bottom edge, each ending in a long spike of tiny packed violet flowers (#5e46a0 #7a5cb8 #a08ad8), the spikes 8-12 px long
column4: tulip_red|plant|One red tulip: a cup-shaped bloom of three overlapping scarlet petals (#a3170d #d32228 #f36555) with a lit top-left edge, on a straight green stem (#425a1d #587827) with two long broad upright leaves (#587827 #75a035), the bloom about 8 px wide, the whole plant about 24 px tall
column5: lavender_bottom|plant|Lavender, the lower half of a tall plant: a bushy clump of many slim grey-green stems and narrow grey-green leaves (#4d6346 #5c7552 #7f9a72 #a3b897) rising from the ground to the top edge, about 26 px wide
column6: tulip_yellow|plant|One yellow tulip: a cup-shaped bloom of three overlapping golden-yellow petals (#d49a0c #f5c518 #ffe86a) with a lit top-left edge, on a straight green stem (#425a1d #587827) with two long broad upright leaves (#587827 #75a035), the bloom about 8 px wide, the whole plant about 24 px tall

column3: short_grass_1@-|tplant|Short grass: a low tuft of 6-9 thin pointed grass blades (#627b40 #78964f #8aad5b #98bf64), about 14 px tall, spread across 24 px
column4: short_grass_2@-|tplant|Short grass: a low tuft of 5-7 thin grass blades, a few bent over (#627b40 #78964f #8aad5b #98bf64), about 12 px tall, leaning a little to the left
column5: short_grass_3@-|tplant|Short grass: two small tufts of thin grass blades side by side (#627b40 #78964f #8aad5b #98bf64), about 10-14 px tall
column6: short_grass_4@-|tplant|Short grass: a tuft of 7-10 thin grass blades fanning out (#627b40 #78964f #8aad5b #98bf64), about 16 px tall, leaning a little to the right

column3: tall_tallgrass_top_1@-|plant|Very tall grass, the upper half: many thin pale grey-green grass blades (#9aa58f #b5bfaa #ccd4c2) running out of the bottom edge and ending in soft drooping pale straw-beige seed heads (#cdbb94 #e2d4b0), about 30 px tall
column4: tall_tallgrass_top_2@-|plant|Very tall grass, the upper half: many thin pale grey-green grass blades (#9aa58f #b5bfaa #ccd4c2) running out of the bottom edge and ending in soft drooping pale green seed heads (#b9c9a0 #d3dfbf), about 28 px tall
column5: tall_tallgrass_bottom|tplant|Very tall grass, the lower half: a dense clump of long thin grass blades (#627b40 #78964f #8aad5b #98bf64) rising from the ground and running out of the top edge, about 28 px wide
column6: tall_tallgrass_top_3@-|plant|Very tall grass, the upper half: many thin pale grey-green grass blades (#9aa58f #b5bfaa #ccd4c2) running out of the bottom edge and ending in soft drooping pale blue-grey seed heads (#aab6c4 #c8d2dc), about 26 px tall

column3: tall_tallgrass_top_4@-|plant|Very tall grass, the upper half: many thin pale grey-green grass blades (#9aa58f #b5bfaa #ccd4c2) running out of the bottom edge and ending in soft drooping pale pink-mauve seed heads (#c9aab0 #e0c8cc), about 28 px tall
column4: bluegrass_1@-|plant|Bluegrass: a low clump of fine pale blue-grey grass blades (#8e9eb4 #a9b8cc #c6d2e0) with tiny open flower sprays at the tips, about 14 px tall
column5: bluegrass_2@-|plant|Bluegrass: two low clumps of fine pale blue-grey grass blades (#8e9eb4 #a9b8cc #c6d2e0) with tiny open flower sprays at the tips, about 12 px tall
column6: bush_stem|cutout|Bush stems: a tangle of thin woody brown stems and twigs (#3a2b1e #5a4330 #7a5c40) running mostly upright from the bottom edge to the top edge and out of the sides, so it tiles, with flat solid magenta between them (about 55% magenta)

column3: porcini_mushroom_1@-|plant|One porcini mushroom: a big round domed chestnut-brown cap (#6b3e22 #8a5430 #b57a4a) on a very fat bulging pale cream stem (#c4b08a #e9dcc0), about 16 px tall
column4: porcini_mushroom_2@-|plant|Two porcini mushrooms: one big (chestnut cap #6b3e22 #8a5430 #b57a4a, fat cream stem #c4b08a #e9dcc0) and one small young one with a pale tan cap beside it, the big one about 14 px tall
column5: porcini_mushroom_3@-|plant|One wide porcini mushroom leaning a little: a broad flat chestnut-brown cap (#6b3e22 #8a5430 #b57a4a) on a fat pale cream stem (#c4b08a #e9dcc0), about 14 px tall
column6: chanterelle_mushroom_1@-|plant|Two chanterelle mushrooms: wavy funnel-shaped golden-orange caps (#d08a1c #f2b134 #ffd970) with frilled rims, ridges running down into short golden stems, about 10 px tall

column3: toadstool_mushroom_1@-|plant|One fly agaric toadstool: a round scarlet cap (#a3170d #d32228 #f36555) with small white warts (#f6e4e1), a slender white stem with a drooping ring under the cap and a round bulb at the foot (#c9bfae #efe8dc), about 18 px tall
column4: toadstool_mushroom_2@-|plant|Two fly agaric toadstools: a tall one (scarlet cap #a3170d #d32228 #f36555 with white warts, white stem with a ring) and a small young one with a round closed cap beside it, the tall one about 20 px tall
column5: toadstool_mushroom_3@-|plant|Three small fly agaric toadstools of different heights, scarlet caps (#a3170d #d32228 #f36555) with white warts on white stems (#c9bfae #efe8dc), the tallest about 14 px
column6: chanterelle_mushroom_2@-|plant|Three small chanterelle mushrooms in a group: wavy funnel-shaped golden-orange caps (#d08a1c #f2b134 #ffd970) with frilled rims on short golden stems, about 8-10 px tall

column3: raspberry_leaves|fleaves|Bush leaves: dense serrated mid-green bramble leaves (#3a5219 #4d6b22 #66892e #80a63c), in their own colours
column4: raspberry_leaves_berried|fleaves|The same bush leaves (#3a5219 #4d6b22 #66892e #80a63c) with 6-8 ripe raspberries among them, each a round 3-4 px crimson berry of tiny drupelets (#8a1030 #c21f45 #e85a78)
column5: snowberry_leaves_berried|fleaves|The same bush leaves (#3a5219 #4d6b22 #66892e #80a63c) with 6-8 small clusters of round pure white snowberries among them (#c9c5be #ecebe6 #ffffff), each berry 2-3 px

column4: porcini_mushroom_2@-|plant|Two porcini mushrooms side by side standing on the bottom edge of their square: a big one (chestnut cap #6b3e22 #8a5430 #b57a4a, fat cream stem #c4b08a #e9dcc0) about 16 px tall and a small young one about 9 px tall

column3: dryads_saddle_mushroom_1@-|cutout|Two stacked halves, each filling the full width and half the height. Upper half: a dryad's saddle bracket fungus seen from straight above, a wide half-disc whose straight edge lies along the middle line, pale tan (#b08f5f #d9b98a #f0dcb4) with concentric rings of dark brown feathery scales (#6e4a2a). Lower half: the same half-disc seen from below, its straight edge along the middle line, a cream pore surface (#d8ccb0 #ece2cc) with a thin tan rim; magenta outside both
column4: dryads_saddle_mushroom_2@-|cutout|Two stacked halves, each filling the full width and half the height. Upper half: a smaller dryad's saddle bracket fungus seen from straight above, a half-disc 24 px wide whose straight edge lies along the middle line, pale tan (#b08f5f #d9b98a #f0dcb4) with rings of dark brown feathery scales (#6e4a2a). Lower half: the same smaller half-disc seen from below, straight edge along the middle line, a cream pore surface (#d8ccb0 #ece2cc); magenta outside both
column5: bush_stem|cutout|Bush stems: 5-7 clear woody brown stems 2-3 px thick (#3a2b1e #5a4330 #7a5c40 #94755a) growing upward from the bottom edge to the top edge, forking into thinner twigs, some leaving through the left and right edges so it tiles, with flat solid magenta between them (about 60% magenta), no speckles
